title: Nice experience
text: Good guide who knew a lot. Also very reassuring for the people who didn't dare much. a good driver.
author: 382sebastiaanr

title: Must do!
text: This excursion is a must if you like adventure and are an active person. Nothing compares to the natural beauty of Costa Brava. We loved kayaking through the caves and really enjoyed the snorkeling. We were able to see starfish, eels, sea urchins and an octopus! Stepan our host made the trip even more enjoyable with his hospitality, knowledge and helpful nature. He was also an excellent driver for anyone that has motion sickness. Hands down this was one of my most favourite adventures ever!
author: Anita_K

title: Exceptional!
text: We had a great time. Tour was great, learned a lot. Family enjoyed the snorkeling and cliff jumping. Stepan was awesome! 10 out of 10!!
author: Josh_B

title: A Perfectly Organized Tour
text: Fantastic trip! Everything went smoothly from start to finish. I traveled with my 12-year-old son, who enjoyed the day trips just as much as I did. Traveling in a smaller group suited us perfectly as well. We had an excellent guide (Stepan) and were treated to breathtaking scenery. The kayaking tour was just the right level of challenge, not too short and not too long. My son absolutely loved jumping off the cliffs. An amazing day that was worth every penny.
author: Jonna_M

title: Absolutely fantastic
text: This trip was fabulous. The weather was great, the location was phenomenal, our guide was fantastic and the activities were all the perfect amount of time. I would absolutely recommend going. It was the capstone of our vacation.
author: Tyla_H

title: This tour has been the...
text: This tour has been the highlight of our trip. You walk down to the beach stopping to identity plants along the way. Following that the group paddles along the coast before taking some time to snorkel and jump from the rocks. We were lucky to go out with Stepan who really cares about nature and shared that knowledge with our group. Next time I’m in the area I would look for more adventure tours to go on with him.
author: Jennifer_G

title: Canadian kayaker
text: The experience was excellent. Stephan was very knowledge and personable the entire trip. He took into consideration our skill levels in all aspects of the trip.
author: Kim_S

title: Great afternoon fun
text: It was my first time kayaking, wasn’t sure what to expect, but I had a great time. The tour guide, Stephan was amazing. Very knowledgeable and patient. Great experience!!
author: Anna_C

title: One of the best...
text: One of the best experience and adventure you could have. My guide was Stephan and he was excellent. He ensured all of us are safe during the hike, kayaking and snorkeling.
author: Rohan_A

title: Brilliant day out!
text: The cliff top walk, kayaking, snorkeling and cliff jumping were absolutely awesome. It was a brilliant day out and our guide Stephen was very knowledgeable and catered to all different skill levels across our group.
